title: Fulton Undergraduate Research Initiative (FURI, Arizona State University)
lab_or_program: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering
description: FURI is the Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering's flagship undergraduate research program. Students design a self-directed, faculty-mentored research or entrepreneurship project and receive a stipend (about $1,500 per semester) plus a supplies budget (about $400), culminating in a campus research symposium. Open to engineering undergraduates across all Fulton Schools.
